relationships.subject: niacin

key_findings: Structure-guided design of HCAD, a peripherally restricted Gi-DREADD, with actuator FCH-2296413 showing a brain:plasma ratio of 0.07 (little BBB penetration).
HCAD in DRG neurons inhibits action potential firing and reduces inflammatory pain.
